computer-systems.hindi: कंप्यूटर में input पहले memory में आता है। CPU निर्देश के अनुसार data पर काम करता है और output देता है। Storage में सहेजी गई जानकारी बिजली बंद होने पर भी रह सकती है।
computer-systems.transcript:
Follow a single instruction from memory to the processor.

The keys provide input. The processor executes an addition instruction using the ALU. Working memory holds the operands and result. The display produces the output: 12.

Which unit performs arithmetic operations? The arithmetic logic unit performs arithmetic and logical operations.

number-systems.hindi: Binary में केवल 0 और 1 होते हैं। दाईं ओर से हर स्थान का मान 1, 2, 4, 8 होता है। जिन स्थानों पर 1 है, उनके मान जोड़कर दशमलव संख्या मिलती है।
number-systems.transcript:
Turn everyday numbers into binary and see every bit light up.

42 = 32 + 8 + 2. Set those bit positions to 1: 00101010₂. Check by adding 32 + 8 + 2 = 42.

What is the decimal value of 1010₂? 1×8 + 0×4 + 1×2 + 0×1 = 10.

logic-gates.hindi: Logic gate का output उसके inputs पर निर्भर करता है। AND में सभी inputs 1 होने चाहिए, OR में कोई एक 1 काफी है और NOT input को उलटता है।
logic-gates.transcript:
Build your intuition for AND, OR, NOT and XOR with live switches.

Use an AND gate. Let A mean cover closed and B mean start pressed. Output = A AND B. Only A=1 and B=1 starts the machine.

Which gate outputs 1 when its two inputs differ? XOR is true for 01 and 10, and false for 00 and 11.

algorithms.hindi: Algorithm समस्या हल करने के स्पष्ट और क्रमबद्ध चरण हैं। पहले input और अपेक्षित output लिखें, फिर हर चरण को छोटे उदाहरण पर जाँचें।
algorithms.transcript:
Break a problem into steps and watch an algorithm come to life.

Compare 7 and 3 → [3,7,5,2]; compare 7 and 5 → [3,5,7,2]; compare 7 and 2 → [3,5,2,7]. More passes are needed to finish sorting.

After the first full pass of ascending bubble sort, which element is in its final position? Each comparison moves the larger value right, so the largest reaches the end.

python-basics.hindi: Python में variable किसी value का नाम है। input से मिला text जरूरत के अनुसार संख्या में बदलें। फिर calculation करें और print से परिणाम देखें।
python-basics.transcript:
Use variables, expressions and input to solve a familiar problem.

Convert each input to a numeric type, add the three marks and divide the total by 3.

What type does input() return? input() returns text, even when the user types digits.

control-flow.hindi: if शर्त के आधार पर रास्ता चुनता है। Loop किसी काम को दोहराता है। हर चक्कर में क्या बदलता है और loop कब रुकेगा, यह समझना जरूरी है।
control-flow.transcript:
Make programs choose a path and repeat useful work.

Start total at zero and add each number produced by range(1, 8). The result is 28.

How many values does range(2, 8, 2) produce? It produces 2, 4 and 6. The stop value 8 is excluded.

data-structures.hindi: List, tuple और dictionary जानकारी को अलग ढंग से रखते हैं। List बदल सकती है, tuple के तत्व बदले नहीं जाते और dictionary में key से value मिलती है।
data-structures.transcript:
Choose between lists, tuples and dictionaries for real tasks.

A dictionary provides an intuitive name-to-score mapping.

Which operation removes the most recently added item from a list-based stack? pop() without an index removes and returns the last item.

functions-files.hindi: Function बार-बार होने वाले काम को नाम देता है। File में data सहेजने के लिए सही mode और encoding चुनें। with block file को बंद करने में मदद करता है।
functions-files.transcript:
Organise work into functions and save results to a text file.

Return the greeting from a function, then write it with a context manager.

Which file mode appends without truncating existing content? Mode a writes at the end, creating the file if needed.

sql.hindi: SQL से table में रखी जानकारी पूछ सकते हैं। WHERE rows चुनता है, SELECT columns चुनता है और ORDER BY परिणाम का क्रम तय करता है।
sql.transcript:
Find, filter and organise records using SQL.

Filter with WHERE and sort the remaining rows with ORDER BY marks DESC.

Which clause filters rows before grouping? WHERE filters individual rows; HAVING filters groups.

networks.hindi: Network में जानकारी packets के रूप में जाती है। हर उपकरण का पता होता है। Router destination की ओर अगला रास्ता चुनता है; DNS नाम को पते से जोड़ता है।
networks.transcript:
Follow a web request through DNS, the network and a server.

The browser resolves the hostname, connects to the server, negotiates TLS for HTTPS, sends an HTTP request, receives the response and renders the page.

What is DNS primarily used for? DNS supplies records associated with names, including IP address records.

cyber-safety.hindi: अनजान link पर तुरंत भरोसा न करें। भेजने वाले और असली domain की जाँच करें। Password या OTP साझा न करें और जरूरत पड़ने पर भरोसेमंद व्यक्ति से मदद लें।
cyber-safety.transcript:
Recognise phishing, protect accounts and respect digital work.

Do not share the OTP or follow the message’s link. Verify through the institution’s independently known website or office and report the suspicious message.

Which action best protects an account? Unique passwords reduce reuse risk; MFA adds another layer of protection.

html.hindi: HTML वेब पेज की संरचना बताता है। Heading, paragraph, link और image के लिए सही element चुनें। रूप और रंग का काम CSS करता है।
html.transcript:
Structure an accessible page using semantic HTML.

Place meaningful content inside main and use descriptive link text.

Which element identifies the main page content? main identifies the dominant content of the document.

cpp.hindi: C++ source code को compiler executable में बदलता है। Variable का type तय करता है कि किस तरह की value रखी जा सकती है। cin input लेता है और cout output देता है।
cpp.transcript:
Read, calculate and print using a compiled language.

Use double for fractional dimensions and reject invalid input.

Which header provides std::cout? The C++ iostream header declares standard stream objects such as std::cout.

operating-systems.hindi: Operating system programs और hardware के बीच संसाधन सँभालता है। यह CPU समय, memory, files और devices का उपयोग व्यवस्थित करता है।
operating-systems.transcript:
See how an operating system coordinates programs and hardware.

The OS schedules processes and coordinates memory and devices. CPU time is shared in short intervals; multiple cores can also execute work simultaneously.

An executing instance of a program is a… A process includes executing instructions and their associated state and resources.

spreadsheets.hindi: Spreadsheet में formula बराबर के चिन्ह से शुरू होता है। Cell references के कारण input बदलते ही परिणाम दोबारा निकलता है। SUM और AVERAGE अलग सवाल हल करते हैं।
spreadsheets.transcript:
Turn a marks sheet into useful totals, averages and decisions.

Put the average in E2, then use IF on E2 to determine the label.

Which reference keeps both its row and column fixed? The dollar signs fix the column B and row 1.

python-functions.hindi: Function में arguments भेजे जाते हैं और return से परिणाम मिलता है। Local variable function के भीतर रहता है। print दिखाता है, return value वापस देता है।
python-functions.transcript:
Turn a repeated task into a clear, reusable Python function.

Check that the maximum is positive and the score is in range, then return the calculation.

Which statement sends a function's result to its caller? return provides a value to the calling expression; print displays text.

lists-and-tuples.hindi: Index शून्य से शुरू होता है। Negative index अंत से गिनता है। List के तत्व बदल सकते हैं, लेकिन tuple की entries बदली नहीं जातीं।
lists-and-tuples.transcript:
Trace sequence positions and choose a mutable or fixed collection.

The first element is index 0 and a slice excludes the stop index; use [1:4].

Which positions are selected by items[1:4]? A slice includes its starting position and excludes its ending position.

recursion.hindi: Recursion में function छोटे रूप में उसी समस्या को बुलाता है। Base case रुकने की शर्त है। उसके बिना calls लगातार बढ़ सकती हैं।
recursion.transcript:
Watch recursive calls build up and return their results.

Calls progress through 3, 2, 1 and 0. Zero stops recursion; the waiting calls then finish.

What makes a recursive function stop safely? The base case ends the calls; the recursive step must move closer to it.

searching.hindi: Linear search एक-एक item देखता है। Binary search के लिए data sorted होना चाहिए; हर कदम में खोज का लगभग आधा हिस्सा हटता है।
searching.transcript:
Compare search strategies and follow every comparison.

Check index 3: 17 is small, so keep the right side. Check index 5: 29 is large. Check index 4 and find 23.

What must be true before binary search can discard half the values? Sorted order makes each middle comparison sufficient to choose a side.

data-structures-plus.hindi: Stack में आखिरी आया item पहले निकलता है। Queue में पहले आया item पहले निकलता है। Undo stack का और टिकट की लाइन queue का उदाहरण है।
data-structures-plus.transcript:
Explore last-in-first-out stacks and first-in-first-out queues.

The queue removes ticket A first, preserving the arrival order.

Which item does a queue normally remove first? FIFO means first in, first out: the oldest item is removed first.

database-design.hindi: अलग entities के लिए अलग tables बनाएँ। Primary key record की पहचान करती है और foreign key संबंधित record से जोड़ती है। इससे दोहराव और गलती कम हो सकती है।
database-design.transcript:
Connect students, courses and marks without repeating each fact.

Store students in students(student_id, name) and test results in results(result_id, student_id, assessment, marks). student_id in results refers to the student.

What does a foreign key do? A foreign key refers to a row's key in a related table.

network-addressing.hindi: IP address और subnet mask मिलकर बताते हैं कि कौन-से addresses एक network में हैं। उसी network के लिए local delivery और बाहर के लिए gateway काम आता है।
network-addressing.transcript:
Separate a network prefix from host addresses with a /24.

Yes. Both share the three octets covered by the 24-bit network prefix: 192.168.10.0/24.

How many leading network bits does /24 describe? The number after the slash gives the number of leading prefix bits.

cybersecurity.hindi: लंबा और अलग password रखें। Multi-factor authentication सुरक्षा की एक और परत जोड़ता है। Password manager और recovery codes सुरक्षित ढंग से सँभालें।
cybersecurity.transcript:
Build habits around unique passwords, MFA and phishing.

Do not open the link or share the code. Contact school IT using a known official address and report the message.

What is the safest response to an unexpected OTP request? An OTP can grant access. Never disclose it, even to a person claiming to be support.

css-layout.hindi: CSS में flex और grid चीजों को व्यवस्थित करते हैं। छोटे screen पर जगह कम होती है, इसलिए flexible widths और responsive rules इस्तेमाल करें।
css-layout.transcript:
Try responsive columns and watch a layout adapt to smaller screens.

Use three flexible Grid columns, then change the grid to one column at a 640px breakpoint.

Which CSS feature applies styles when a screen meets a condition? A media query lets CSS respond to viewport conditions such as its width.

colour-codes.hindi: RGB में red, green और blue की मात्रा से रंग बनता है। केवल सुंदर रंग काफी नहीं; text और background में पढ़ने योग्य contrast भी होना चाहिए।
colour-codes.transcript:
Blend RGB light, read a hexadecimal colour and check text contrast.

0 is 00, 128 is 80 and 255 is FF; write the channels in that order: #0080FF.

What does #0000FF represent? CSS hex pairs are red, green and blue. FF is the highest channel value.

half-adder.hindi: Full adder में A, B और carry-in तीन inputs होते हैं। Sum और carry-out दो outputs मिलते हैं। तीनों inputs 1 हों तो sum 1 और carry 1 होता है।
half-adder.transcript:
Toggle A, B and carry-in to see sum and carry change.

1+1+1 is 3, or binary 11. The lower bit is S and the next bit is carry-out.

A full adder combines three inputs to produce which two outputs? The sum bit and the carry-out represent a binary addition result.

hardware-io.hindi: Input device बाहरी जानकारी को कंप्यूटर तक पहुँचाता है। Output device परिणाम दिखाता है। Touchscreen input और output दोनों काम करता है।
hardware-io.transcript:
An input device converts an action or measurement into data. An output device presents the result. A feedback system measures the effect of an output and uses that measurement as a later input; input and output are roles in a process, not permanent labels on an entire machine.

31°C is input data; comparing 31 with 28 is processing; turning on the fan is output. A later reading of 27°C causes the controller to turn the fan off. The program needs a clear boundary rule for exactly 28°C.

Which reading turns this controller on? Only 29 is strictly greater than the threshold 28.

memory-hierarchy.hindi: Registers और cache तेज लेकिन छोटे होते हैं। RAM बड़ी working memory है। Storage अधिक data रखता है पर आम तौर पर धीमा होता है।
memory-hierarchy.transcript:
Memory is organised as a hierarchy because speed, capacity, cost and persistence trade off. Registers hold immediate operands; caches retain recently used blocks; RAM holds active programs; secondary storage keeps files. These layers cooperate rather than replace each other.

Recently accessed blocks may remain in cache, reducing slower RAM accesses. A larger array may exceed cache capacity, so the benefit depends on the working set. Cache presence alone does not guarantee a specific time.

Which normally retains data without power? An SSD is non-volatile storage; registers and ordinary working RAM are volatile.

data-units.hindi: एक byte में 8 bits होते हैं। kB में 1000 bytes और KiB में 1024 bytes होते हैं। दोनों इकाइयों को एक जैसा मानने से गणना गलत हो सकती है।
data-units.transcript:
A bit represents one binary choice. Eight bits form a byte. Capacity calculations must keep bits, bytes and prefixes separate: decimal kilo means 1000, while kibi means 1024. A transfer rate in megabits per second cannot be compared directly with a file size in megabytes.

There are 307,200 pixels. Multiplying by 24 gives 7,372,800 bits; dividing by 8 gives 921,600 bytes, or 900 KiB. The file on disk may differ because of headers or compression.

How many bytes are in 64 bits? Divide the bit count by eight.

signed-binary.hindi: Two’s complement में n bits की सीमा माइनस 2 की घात n-1 से लेकर 2 की घात n-1 से एक कम तक होती है। Carry और signed overflow अलग बातें हैं।
signed-binary.transcript:
A fixed-width bit pattern has meaning only under an interpretation. In eight-bit unsigned form, 11111111 represents 255. In eight-bit two’s complement, it represents −1. The representable range for n-bit two’s complement is −2^(n−1) through 2^(n−1)−1.

+5 is 00000101. Inversion gives 11111010; adding one gives 11111011. The high bit has weight −128, so the value is −128 + 64 + 32 + 16 + 8 + 2 + 1 = −5.

What is the eight-bit signed range? Eight-bit two’s complement has 256 values, from −128 to 127.

unicode-encoding.hindi: Unicode हर character को code point देता है। UTF-8 उसे bytes में encode करता है। एक character हमेशा एक byte नहीं होता।
unicode-encoding.transcript:
Unicode assigns code points to characters. UTF-8 is one encoding that turns those code points into bytes. The number of characters, code points and bytes can differ; a visible character may also contain multiple code points. This matters when storing Indian-language text.

Their code points can require different numbers of UTF-8 bytes. For example A uses one byte while the check mark ✓ uses three. Size limits should specify whether they count bytes, code points or displayed characters.

Which converts a Python string to UTF-8 bytes? encode creates a byte representation using the selected encoding.

boot-process.hindi: बिजली मिलने पर firmware hardware की शुरुआती जाँच करता है। Bootloader operating system का kernel load करता है, फिर services और login शुरू होते हैं।
boot-process.transcript:
Booting is the sequence that prepares hardware and loads an operating system. Firmware begins before the operating system exists in RAM. It identifies a boot target, and a boot loader arranges for a kernel to run. Exact details vary across devices and firmware designs.

No. Showing firmware output proves at least part of the display path works. The next investigation concerns boot-device detection, boot order, boot-loader configuration or OS startup. A failed login is a different, later-stage problem.

Which normally starts first? Firmware executes before loading the operating system.

process-states.hindi: Process ready, running या waiting अवस्था में हो सकता है। CPU मिलने पर ready से running जाता है; input की प्रतीक्षा में waiting हो सकता है।
process-states.transcript:
A program is stored instructions; a process is an executing instance with state and resources. A process may contain multiple threads that share parts of its address space. Running, ready and blocked describe whether execution currently has CPU time or is waiting.

The requesting thread can block while another ready task uses the CPU. When the data arrives, the waiting thread becomes ready; it may still wait for scheduling before running again. Ready does not mean currently running.

An I/O completion usually moves a blocked task into which state? The task becomes eligible to run; the scheduler determines when it gets CPU time.

cpu-scheduling.hindi: Scheduler तय करता है कि CPU अगला कौन-सा process चलाए। Waiting time और turnaround time अलग माप हैं। नीति बदलने से इनके मान बदल सकते हैं।
cpu-scheduling.transcript:
A scheduler chooses among ready tasks. Different policies optimise different goals such as response time, throughput and fairness. Waiting time counts time spent ready but not running; turnaround time measures completion time minus arrival time. State all assumptions before comparing algorithms.

A runs 0–4, B runs 4–6, C runs 6–9. Their waiting times are 0, 4 and 6 ms. Average waiting time is (0+4+6)/3 = 10/3 ms. No I/O or switching cost is assumed.

For the original order, when does task C finish? C begins at 6 ms and needs 3 ms of CPU time.

virtual-memory.hindi: Virtual address को operating system और hardware physical memory से जोड़ते हैं। जरूरी page RAM में न हो तो page fault होता है।
virtual-memory.transcript:
Virtual memory gives a process an address space whose addresses are translated to physical memory. Paging divides that address space into equal-sized pages and physical memory into frames. A page table records mappings and access permissions. Virtual memory is more than a synonym for a disk swap file.

2500 = 2×1024 + 452, so the page is 2 and the offset is 452. The physical address is 7×1024 + 452 = 7620. This example assumes the entry is present and permits the access.

Which part is unchanged by this translation? The offset identifies the same position within the selected frame.

file-systems.hindi: File system नाम और folders को storage में रखे blocks से जोड़ता है। File का नाम, metadata और असली content अलग भूमिकाएँ निभाते हैं।
file-systems.transcript:
A filesystem organises persistent data and metadata. A file name identifies a directory entry; a path explains how to reach it. Absolute paths start from a root, while relative paths depend on a current directory. File extensions are naming conventions, not proof of content type.

If the working directory is the project root, the file is inside notes and its relative path is notes/chapter1.txt. Opening only chapter1.txt looks in the current directory. The failure should be diagnosed before creating a duplicate file.

A relative path is interpreted from what location? Its meaning depends on the working directory.

permissions.hindi: Read, write और execute permissions अलग अधिकार हैं। हर user को केवल उतना अधिकार दें जितना उसके काम के लिए जरूरी है।
permissions.transcript:
Permissions control which operations an account can perform. Authentication establishes an identity; authorisation decides what that identity may do. Least privilege means granting only the access necessary for a task and reviewing it when responsibilities change.

The backend must reject the request when the session lacks teacher privileges. The interface is not a trusted enforcement boundary because a user can construct requests without using its buttons.

What is authorisation? Authorisation checks permitted actions and resources.

deadlocks.hindi: Deadlock में processes एक-दूसरे के पास मौजूद संसाधन की प्रतीक्षा करते रहते हैं। Resource लेने का तय क्रम इस स्थिति को रोकने में मदद कर सकता है।
deadlocks.transcript:
A deadlock is a situation in which tasks wait for resources held by one another and none can proceed. A classic resource model identifies mutual exclusion, hold-and-wait, no forced preemption and circular wait as necessary conditions. A slow task is not automatically deadlocked.

A waits for B to release the scanner; B waits for A to release the printer. Neither voluntarily releases its held lock while waiting. The dependency graph contains A→B→A, indicating the cycle in this simple example.

Which design breaks the example’s circular wait? A global resource order prevents a cycle of incompatible acquisition orders.

os-services.hindi: Program file या device तक सीधे मनमाने तरीके से नहीं जाता। System calls के जरिए operating system से नियंत्रित सेवा माँगता है।
os-services.transcript:
The OS manages resources and provides controlled services to programs. Applications request operations such as reading files, creating processes and communicating through system interfaces. Protection separates ordinary application code from privileged operations that could affect the whole machine.

The program requests a read. The OS checks the handle and permissions, locates the data, and copies or maps the result as appropriate. The call reports how many bytes were read or an error; the application must handle that result.

Which component normally enforces protected hardware access? The kernel provides controlled access to privileged resources.

backup-recovery.hindi: Backup तभी उपयोगी है जब उससे data वापस लाया जा सके। अलग स्थान पर प्रतियाँ रखें और समय-समय पर restore करके जाँचें।
backup-recovery.transcript:
A backup is a separate recoverable copy, not merely another shortcut to the same file. Recovery plans must consider accidental deletion, corruption and loss of the original device. Version history helps recover earlier states, while synchronisation alone can propagate a deletion.

Sync replicated the deletion. Recovery depends on separate version history, recycle-bin retention or a backup. Test restoration before relying on a service for important teaching material.

Which is the strongest evidence that a backup is usable? A restoration check verifies that the saved data can actually be recovered.

boolean-laws.hindi: Boolean algebra logic expression को सरल बनाती है। De Morgan नियम में AND और OR बदलते हैं तथा हर input का complement लिया जाता है।
boolean-laws.transcript:
Boolean algebra models values 0 and 1 using operations such as AND, OR and NOT. Algebraic laws let us transform an expression without changing its truth table. In Boolean notation, multiplication often means AND and addition often means OR, not ordinary arithmetic.

A AND B is 0, so its complement is 1. NOT A is 0 and NOT B is 1; their OR is 1. Matching this row alone is not a full proof, so repeat for 00, 10 and 11.

What is NOT(A OR B) equivalent to? De Morgan’s law exchanges OR with AND and complements both inputs.

multiplexer.hindi: Multiplexer कई inputs में से एक चुनता है। Select bits तय करते हैं कि कौन-सा data input output तक पहुँचेगा।
multiplexer.transcript:
A multiplexer selects one of several data inputs and forwards it to an output. A 2-to-1 multiplexer needs one select bit. Selection is useful when multiple possible sources share a destination, such as operands entering a processor’s arithmetic unit.

For S=0, Y=1. For S=1, Y=0. Changing S redirects the data path even though neither data input changes. A four-input multiplexer generally needs two select bits.

How many select bits choose one of four inputs? Two binary select bits represent four possible choices.

decoder.hindi: Decoder binary code के अनुसार एक output line सक्रिय करता है। दो input bits से चार अलग outputs चुने जा सकते हैं।
decoder.transcript:
A decoder converts an encoded input into an active output line. In an ideal active-high 2-to-4 decoder, each two-bit input selects exactly one of four outputs when enabled. Real devices may use active-low outputs or additional enable pins, so read the chosen device’s datasheet.

Y2 is 1 in the active-high enabled model; Y0, Y1 and Y3 are 0. This is a one-hot representation of the input value 2.

In the stated model, input 11 activates which output? Binary 11 selects output number 3.

cpu-buses.hindi: Address bus स्थान बताती है, data bus value ले जाती है और control signals read या write का काम तय करते हैं।
cpu-buses.transcript:
A bus carries information between components. An address identifies a location, data carries the value being transferred, and control signals describe actions such as read or write. Bus width and addressable unit together determine what an address can identify.

Sixteen address bits represent 2^16 = 65,536 distinct addresses. If each address selects one byte, the address space is 65,536 bytes or 64 KiB. An eight-bit data bus does not reduce the number of addresses.

A 16-bit byte address space contains how many addresses? There are 2^16 possible address patterns.

8085-architecture.hindi: 8085 में accumulator, registers, ALU और control unit मिलकर instruction चलाते हैं। Program counter अगले instruction का पता रखता है।
8085-architecture.transcript:
The 8085 is an eight-bit microprocessor with an accumulator, general-purpose registers, flags, a program counter and a stack pointer. Register roles matter when reading assembly: instructions describe transfers and operations on these named storage locations. The model is historical and educational.

A contains 2AH after the first instruction. MOV copies that value into B, so both registers contain 2AH. Copying a register value does not erase the source.

Which register is the accumulator? The accumulator is register A.

8085-addressing.hindi: Immediate addressing में value instruction में होती है। Register addressing में register का data लिया जाता है; memory addressing में पते से data मिलता है।
8085-addressing.transcript:
An addressing mode explains where an instruction obtains its operand. Immediate data is included in the instruction; register addressing names a register; direct addressing supplies a memory address; register-indirect addressing uses a register pair to identify a location.

The first loads the literal value 25H into A. The second reads memory location 0025H and loads whatever byte is stored there. Without knowing that memory value, you cannot predict A for the second case.

What does M represent in MOV A,M? M is the 8085 notation for the memory location pointed to by HL.

8085-flags.hindi: 8085 flags पिछले arithmetic या logic परिणाम की स्थिति बताते हैं। Zero और carry अलग संकेत हैं। FF में 01 जोड़ने पर 8-bit परिणाम 00 और carry 1 मिलता है।
8085-flags.transcript:
Status flags record properties of certain operation results. In the 8085, common flags include carry, zero, sign, parity and auxiliary carry. Each instruction’s flag effects must be checked; not every instruction changes every flag.

The mathematical sum is 100H. A stores 00H and carry becomes 1. Zero becomes 1, sign becomes 0, and parity is even because zero has zero one bits. Auxiliary carry is also 1 for this addition.

Is the number of one bits in 03H even? 03H is 00000011, which has two set bits.

8085-stack.hindi: Stack last-in first-out तरीके से काम करता है। PUSH और POP जोड़े में उपयोग करें। CALL return address सहेजता है और RET उसे वापस लेता है।
8085-stack.transcript:
A stack follows last-in, first-out order. The 8085 uses the stack for operations such as saving register pairs and storing return addresses during subroutine calls. A valid stack pointer and reserved stack memory are prerequisites for reliable stack operations.

Save the BC pair before changing it, perform the subroutine work, and restore the pair before returning. Every saved value must be restored in reverse order. The subroutine must also preserve the call’s return-address discipline.

Which saved pair is popped first? The stack uses last-in, first-out order.

8085-branch.hindi: Conditional jump किसी flag को जाँचकर रास्ता बदलता है। CMP तुलना के लिए flags बदलता है, लेकिन accumulator की value नहीं बदलता।
8085-branch.transcript:
Conditional branches use flag state to decide whether execution continues sequentially or jumps to another address. A comparison may set flags as if subtraction had occurred while leaving the compared accumulator value unchanged. Instruction-specific behaviour matters when predicting a branch.

The comparison yields a zero difference, so Z is set and JZ transfers control to EQUAL. A remains 05H. The jump relies on the comparison’s flags still being current.

Which flag is tested by JZ? JZ branches when the zero flag is set.

interrupts.hindi: Interrupt CPU का ध्यान किसी घटना की ओर खींचता है। सेवा पूरी होने के बाद program आगे चल सकता है। सभी interrupts की priority एक जैसी नहीं होती।
interrupts.transcript:
An interrupt requests attention from the processor so that an event can be handled without continuously checking it in a tight polling loop. The processor transfers control to an interrupt service routine according to its architecture and current interrupt settings.

The CPU can perform other work between events. When input arrives, the device requests service. Polling is simpler in some designs but can waste time or miss timing requirements if the polling interval is poorly chosen.

What is the purpose of an interrupt service routine? It performs the work needed to service the interrupt and allows execution to continue appropriately.

network-layers.hindi: हर network layer अलग जिम्मेदारी सँभालती है। भेजते समय headers जुड़ते हैं और प्राप्त करते समय सही क्रम में पढ़े और हटाए जाते हैं।
network-layers.transcript:
Layering separates networking responsibilities so that applications need not implement every detail of physical transmission. Encapsulation adds control information around data as it passes through a protocol stack. Different teaching models group these responsibilities into different numbers of layers.

HTTP describes the application message. TCP supplies a reliable ordered byte stream for this example. IP supports addressing and routing across networks. A local link technology such as Ethernet or Wi-Fi carries the next-hop frame. Modern web traffic can also use other transports, such as QUIC.

Which layer’s role includes routing IP packets? Routing across networks is a network-layer function.

dns.hindi: DNS domain name का address खोजने में मदद करता है। Cache में उत्तर मिलने पर दोबारा पूरी खोज जरूरी नहीं होती। DNS खुद webpage नहीं भेजता।
dns.transcript:
DNS is a distributed naming system. A browser often needs an address associated with a host name before contacting its server. DNS records have types and lifetimes; a domain name is not itself an IP address, and a name can have several relevant records.

No. The failure occurs before a successful server connection in this scenario. Check the name, resolver response and network configuration. Styling can only affect a page after content is obtained or already cached locally.

What does an A record contain? An A record maps a name to an IPv4 address.

tcp-udp.hindi: TCP क्रम और delivery की reliability सँभालता है। UDP छोटे स्वतंत्र datagrams भेजता है; application को जरूरत के अनुसार अतिरिक्त व्यवस्था करनी पड़ सकती है।
tcp-udp.transcript:
Transport protocols deliver data between application endpoints. TCP presents a reliable ordered byte stream with flow and congestion control. UDP provides datagrams without those guarantees at the UDP layer. Applications may add reliability or other features above UDP when needed.

For real-time conversation, delayed audio may be less useful than continuing with the current audio. This does not mean all UDP traffic is automatically fast or all real-time protocols ignore loss; the application’s design determines the trade-off.

Which property does TCP provide to applications? TCP provides a reliable ordered byte-stream abstraction, not zero delay or unlimited capacity.

http-tls.hindi: HTTP request और response का नियम है। TLS रास्ते में data को encrypt करता है और server की पहचान जाँचने में मदद करता है। HTTPS वेबसाइट की हर बात सही होने की गारंटी नहीं है।
http-tls.transcript:
HTTP describes requests and responses such as GET /notes and a status code. HTTPS carries HTTP through a protected connection, typically using TLS. Encryption protects data in transit, while server identity checks help the browser determine which endpoint it is communicating with.

No. HTTPS protects the communication channel; the server must separately check publishing permissions. Encrypted delivery of an unauthorised action is still an authorisation failure.

Which layer of protection does HTTPS primarily provide? TLS protects the channel and supports server authentication; application checks remain necessary.

network-devices.hindi: Switch local network में frames आगे भेजता है। Router अलग networks को जोड़ता है। Access point wireless devices को network से जोड़ता है।
network-devices.transcript:
Network devices have different forwarding roles. An Ethernet switch forwards frames within a local network using learned link-layer addresses. A router forwards packets between IP networks. A wireless access point connects wireless clients to a local network; a home appliance may combine several roles.

It often combines a router, Ethernet switch, wireless access point and other services. Calling the entire box a router is convenient, but separating its roles makes troubleshooting more precise.

Which role forwards packets between IP networks? A router selects paths between networks.

network-topologies.hindi: Topology बताती है कि devices किस ढंग से जुड़े हैं। Star में central device जरूरी है। किसी connection के टूटने का असर व्यवस्था पर निर्भर करता है।
network-topologies.transcript:
A topology describes how nodes and links are arranged. Physical topology concerns actual connections; logical topology concerns communication relationships. Star, bus, ring and mesh models help compare cost, failure behaviour and manageability, but real deployments may combine them.

A failed PC cable usually disconnects that PC. A failed central switch can disconnect every PC relying on it. Redundant design can reduce this dependency, but redundancy must be deliberately planned and tested.

How many links connect four nodes in a full undirected mesh? Use n(n−1)/2, giving 6.

dhcp.hindi: DHCP device को सीमित समय के लिए IP configuration दे सकता है। Address, mask, gateway और DNS settings सही होने पर network का उपयोग आसान होता है।
dhcp.transcript:
A host needs compatible network configuration to communicate. DHCP can supply an address lease and other settings such as a default gateway and DNS servers. An address lease is time-limited and managed; it is not a permanent ownership claim over an address.

Check DHCP reachability, available leases and client configuration. Link association and network-layer configuration are different stages. A device can show a wireless connection while still being unable to reach its gateway.

What does DHCP commonly provide? DHCP automates host configuration such as address leases and related options.

html-semantics.hindi: Semantic HTML content का अर्थ बताता है। nav navigation के लिए और main मुख्य content के लिए है। सही structure screen reader और keyboard users को मदद देता है।
html-semantics.transcript:
Semantic HTML describes the meaning of content, not only its visual appearance. Headings, navigation, main content, articles and buttons give browsers and assistive technologies a useful structure. A large bold paragraph does not become a heading merely because it looks like one.

Use an anchor with a meaningful href for navigation. It supplies familiar link semantics and keyboard behaviour. A button is appropriate when the control performs an in-page action instead.

Which element normally performs an in-page action? A button is the appropriate interactive control for an action.

css-box-model.hindi: CSS box में content, padding, border और margin अलग हिस्से हैं। box-sizing बदलने से घोषित width की गणना का तरीका बदलता है।
css-box-model.transcript:
A CSS box has content, padding, border and margin. Padding sits inside the border; margin separates the box from neighbouring layout. The box-sizing property determines whether a declared width refers only to content or includes padding and borders.

The total is 200 + 10 + 10 + 2 + 2 = 224px. With border-box and the same declared width, the border box is 200px, leaving 176px for content. Margins would be additional.

What is included in a border-box width? border-box includes content, padding and borders but excludes margins.

forms-validation.hindi: हर form field के साथ label होना चाहिए। Browser validation उपयोगकर्ता की मदद करती है, लेकिन server को भी input की जाँच करनी चाहिए।
forms-validation.transcript:
A form gathers data through named controls. Labels explain what to enter, and native input types can provide useful validation. Client-side validation improves feedback but cannot establish trust, because a request can be sent without using the page’s form.

No. A caller can construct a request directly. The backend must enforce the same allowed range and reject values such as −1, 101 or a non-number. The browser constraints remain useful for ordinary users.

Where must security-relevant validation run? The server must not rely on client-side controls as a security boundary.

dom-events.hindi: Browser HTML से DOM tree बनाता है। Event listener click जैसी घटना पर function चलाता है, जो page के दिखते content को बदल सकता है।
dom-events.transcript:
The Document Object Model represents a page as a tree of objects. An event reports an interaction or other occurrence. Event handlers can update state and change what the browser displays. A displayed change does not automatically mean data was saved on the server.

Activation is the input event. A state value such as answerVisible changes from false to true. The explanation appearing on screen is output. If the page refreshes and no persistence was used, the state may return to its initial value.

What does an event handler do? A handler responds to an event; its actual effects depend on the code it runs.

spreadsheet-references.hindi: Relative reference formula copy करने पर बदलता है। Dollar चिन्ह से row या column स्थिर किया जाता है। Tax rate के लिए fixed cell उपयोगी है।
spreadsheet-references.transcript:
A cell reference identifies data used by a formula. Relative references shift when a formula is copied; absolute references keep the specified row and column fixed. Mixed references fix one part. Understanding reference movement is essential when filling a worksheet accurately.

It becomes =B3*$F$1. The relative price reference moves one row; the absolute tax-rate reference stays in F1. If F1 holds 0.18 and B3 holds 200, the tax is 36.

Which reference fixes both column F and row 1? $F$1 is absolute in both dimensions.

spreadsheet-functions.hindi: SUM जोड़ता है, AVERAGE औसत निकालता है और IF शर्त के अनुसार परिणाम चुनता है। Blank cell और zero को हमेशा समान न समझें।
spreadsheet-functions.transcript:
Functions such as SUM, AVERAGE, MIN and MAX summarise ranges. Their results depend on which cells are included and how text, blanks or errors are treated. A formula that calculates successfully can still answer the wrong question if the range is incorrect.

The total is 80 and the average is 80/3, approximately 26.67. A display rounded to two decimals changes presentation, not necessarily the stored result used by later formulas.

What is the average of 28,25,27,20? The sum 100 divided by four observations is 25.

charts.hindi: Chart सवाल के अनुसार चुनें। समय के साथ बदलाव के लिए line chart और categories की तुलना के लिए bar chart उपयोगी है। Axis और units स्पष्ट रखें।
charts.transcript:
A chart is a visual argument about data. Bar charts compare categories, line charts commonly show ordered change, and scatter plots show pairs of numeric measurements. The choice of chart, scale, labels and units affects how a reader interprets the evidence.

A bar or column chart is a suitable starting point because the class names are categories and marks are numeric. Use a clearly labeled score axis and an appropriate baseline. A connecting line could misleadingly imply a continuous trend between unrelated categories.

What usually suits ordered change over time? A line chart can show an ordered time series when its axes and units are clear.

documents.hindi: Styles से headings और paragraphs का रूप एक जैसा रहता है। केवल बड़ा और bold text बनाने के बजाय सही heading style लगाने से navigation भी बेहतर होता है।
documents.transcript:
A structured document separates meaning from manual formatting. Styles identify headings, body text and captions consistently. A practical report becomes easier to navigate, update and export when its structure is clear instead of being simulated with repeated spaces and bold text.

The title may be ordinary text with manual formatting rather than a heading style. Apply the correct heading style and update the contents field. Visual size alone does not establish document structure.

What should identify a report section? A heading style records structural meaning and supports navigation and contents generation.

presentations.hindi: हर slide पर एक मुख्य विचार रखें। बड़ा readable text और अर्थपूर्ण visual चुनें। Speaker notes में विस्तार रखें और presentation का अभ्यास करें।
presentations.transcript:
A teaching slide should support an explanation rather than compete with it. One clear claim, a relevant diagram and a small example usually communicate more effectively than a dense copied paragraph. Speaker notes can preserve detail that does not need to occupy the screen.

Use a sorted array and target, show the first middle comparison, show the retained half, show the next comparison, and explain the stopping condition. Keep the same array positions visually consistent so learners can follow what was eliminated.

What is a useful reason to animate an explanation? Animation helps when it makes a meaningful change or sequence visible.

communication.hindi: अच्छे communication में स्पष्ट संदेश और feedback दोनों होते हैं। सुनकर अपने शब्दों में अर्थ दोहराएँ ताकि गलतफहमी पकड़ी जा सके।
communication.transcript:
Communication includes a sender, message, medium, receiver and feedback, but successful understanding also depends on context. Active listening means checking meaning rather than merely waiting to speak. In technical work, ambiguity can cause incorrect implementations even when everyone is cooperative.

For example: “The login page opens, but submitting my school account displays ‘access denied’. I expected the notes library. The problem began after my role changed.” This narrows the stage and avoids guessing a cause.

Which response demonstrates active listening? Restatement and confirmation help establish shared understanding.

self-management.hindi: बड़े काम को छोटे measurable steps में बाँटें। प्राथमिकता तय करें, समय रखें और अंत में अपने परिणाम की समीक्षा करें।
self-management.transcript:
Self-management turns an intention into a realistic sequence of actions. A useful plan identifies a deliverable, breaks it into tasks, estimates effort and includes time for review. Progress should be assessed against completed work rather than only time spent or visual activity.

Identify missing programs, complete and test a small batch each day, reserve Thursday for outputs and explanations, and use Friday for final checking and submission. Adjust this schedule to the actual available class time and task size.

Which goal is most measurable? The last goal states an observable completion criterion.

teamwork.hindi: Team में जिम्मेदारियाँ स्पष्ट रखें और dependencies पहचानें। असहमति में व्यक्ति के बजाय काम और प्रमाण पर चर्चा करें।
teamwork.transcript:
Teamwork requires shared outcomes, clear responsibilities and visible handovers. Dividing work does not remove the need to integrate it. Constructive feedback describes an observable issue and its effect, then helps the receiver identify a useful next action.

They should agree on request fields, endpoint, response shape, authentication behaviour and error messages. Both pieces can work separately yet fail together if those expectations differ.

What belongs in a useful handover? A handover supports the next action with concrete status and context.

entrepreneurship.hindi: व्यवसाय शुरू करने से पहले ग्राहक की समस्या समझें। Revenue और profit अलग हैं; लागत घटाने के बाद ही profit मिलता है।
entrepreneurship.transcript:
Entrepreneurship begins with understanding a problem and the people affected by it. A product idea becomes stronger when assumptions about demand, cost and value are tested. Revenue is money earned from sales; profit also accounts for the relevant costs.

Revenue is ₹400 and variable cost is ₹200, leaving ₹200 toward fixed costs and profit. It is not automatically ₹200 net profit because rent, equipment and other fixed costs may still apply.

What is profit in the worked extension? Subtract both variable and stated fixed costs from revenue.

green-skills.hindi: उपकरण का जीवन बढ़ाना, ऊर्जा बचाना और e-waste को सही जगह देना उपयोगी green practices हैं। केवल नया उपकरण खरीदना हमेशा सबसे अच्छा विकल्प नहीं होता।
green-skills.transcript:
Sustainable computing considers energy, material use, maintenance, reuse and responsible end-of-life handling. A device’s impact includes manufacturing and disposal as well as electricity while it runs. Extending useful life can matter, provided security and reliability remain appropriate.

60 W × 5 h = 300 Wh = 0.3 kWh. This is operating energy for that period, not the device’s entire lifecycle impact. Multiply by the relevant electricity rate if estimating cost.

Which value is a unit of energy? A kilowatt-hour measures energy; a watt measures power.

digital-citizenship.hindi: Online व्यवहार का असर दूसरे लोगों पर पड़ता है। किसी की photo साझा करने से पहले सहमति लें और अपुष्ट जानकारी आगे न बढ़ाएँ।
digital-citizenship.transcript:
Responsible digital participation includes respecting privacy, seeking consent where appropriate and limiting unnecessary data collection. Public availability does not automatically justify every use of a person’s information. A classroom platform should distinguish public learning material from private student records.

Consider whether identifiable student results need to be public, the school’s rules, required consent and a less identifying alternative. A screenshot can reveal more than its central message, including account details at the edges.

What is data minimisation? Minimisation limits collection to what is necessary for the purpose.

copyright-licensing.hindi: Internet पर उपलब्ध सामग्री अपने-आप public domain नहीं बनती। License की शर्तें पढ़ें; attribution देना और अनुमति होना अलग बातें हैं।
copyright-licensing.transcript:
Copyright and licensing affect how material may be copied, adapted and shared. Attribution identifies a source but does not by itself grant permission. A licence states conditions under which use is allowed; different licences can impose different requirements on redistribution and modification.

No. Credit is not the same as permission. The teacher must check the applicable licence, permission or legal exception and use an allowed sharing method. Linking to an authorised public video can differ from redistributing a copy.

Does attribution alone always permit redistribution? Permission depends on the licence or another applicable legal basis, not attribution alone.

database-keys.hindi: Primary key हर row की अलग पहचान है। Foreign key किसी संबंधित table की key को reference करती है और संबंध की वैधता बनाए रखने में मदद करती है।
database-keys.transcript:
A relational table represents rows with defined attributes. A candidate key uniquely identifies a row; the chosen primary key is one candidate key. A foreign key links values to a referenced key and helps preserve referential integrity. Meaningful relationships should be expressed explicitly.

Two students can share a name, and a name can change. A stable assigned identifier avoids confusing identity with a descriptive attribute. The identifier still needs a uniqueness constraint.

Which rule prevents two students sharing the same primary-key value? A primary key identifies each row uniquely.

normalisation.hindi: Normalization में dependencies देखकर tables बाँटे जाते हैं। उद्देश्य अनावश्यक duplication और update anomalies कम करना है, केवल ज्यादा tables बनाना नहीं।
normalisation.transcript:
Normalisation organises relational data to reduce certain forms of redundancy and update anomalies. It uses dependencies between attributes, not just visual neatness. A useful first step is to identify what each row represents and which attributes depend on its key.

Changing only some rows creates contradictory teacher names for the same course. A separate Course record can store the teacher once, while Enrolment records reference C1. This addresses the demonstrated redundancy.

What is an update anomaly? Repeated facts can disagree when only some copies are changed.

sql-grouping.hindi: GROUP BY rows को समूहों में बाँटता है। WHERE grouping से पहले rows छाँटता है, जबकि HAVING aggregate के बाद groups छाँटता है।
sql-grouping.transcript:
GROUP BY collects rows with shared grouping values so aggregates can be computed for each group. WHERE filters rows before grouping; HAVING filters grouped results. Confusing these stages can produce an invalid query or a different answer from the intended question.

Class A has average 85; class B has average 70. HAVING AVG(marks)>=80 keeps only A. A WHERE marks>=80 filter would remove B’s row before grouping, which is a different operation.

Which clause can filter on COUNT(*) after grouping? HAVING can apply conditions to grouped aggregate results.

transactions.hindi: Transaction संबंधित changes को एक काम की तरह सँभालता है। सफल होने पर COMMIT और गलती पर ROLLBACK उपयोगी है। पैसे transfer में दोनों updates साथ सफल होने चाहिए।
transactions.transcript:
A transaction groups operations into a logical unit of work. Atomicity means the group succeeds as a unit or is not partly applied; consistency, isolation and durability describe other important transaction properties. Their exact guarantees depend on the database and chosen settings.

Applying only the debit loses money from the represented accounts; applying only the credit creates an inconsistent result. Atomic handling avoids this partial-update state. A real financial system needs additional validation and controls beyond this teaching example.
